subject: Instrumentation & Observability add-ons — retention horizon, tracing throughput, and crediting
messages:
From: Anya Petrova <anya.p@cloudcatalog.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cloudcatalog.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons — retention and tracing pricing questions

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo last week — CloudCatalog leadership liked the latency profiles on Redwood Dedicated. We're trying to firm up numbers for FY27 budgeting. A few questions from product and procurement:

- We're looking at retention for event-level telemetry and traces. Target retention horizon: 90 days cold storage for aggregated traces and 30 days for full-fidelity trace spans. Estimated ingest: ~1.8 TB/day (peak 3 TB/day) and ~1.2M spans/day.
- We also want the advanced dashboards bundle (interactive runbooks, cross-model tracing, custom alerting).
- Procurement asked: how are these billed (GB-month vs credits vs seats), and is there a committed-credit discount ladder (12-month, 24-month)?
- Any promotional credits or onboarding waivers for fast close?

Could you send a simple cost estimate and any available tier/discounting options? We need a formal proposal by EOD Friday (Aug 7) to slot into our procurement review.

Thanks,
Anya
Anya Petrova
Head of Observability Product
CloudCatalog Inc.

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Petrova <anya.p@cloudcatalog.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention and tracing pricing questions

Hi Anya — great to hear the demo resonated. Short answer up front: we bill retention as GB-month (cold/economy tiers available), tracing ingestion by 1M-span blocks, and advanced dashboards as a bundle priced by active dashboard seats plus a fixed platform connector fee.

I'm attaching a quick tiered estimate (RI_pricing_tiers_v3.xlsx) and a 90-day retention estimate we ran for similar traffic (CloudCatalog_retention_estimate.pdf). High-level notes:

- Retention: $0.18/GB-month for hot 30-day retention, $0.06/GB-month for cold 90-day aggregated storage.
- Tracing: $0.50 per 1M spans ingested (includes compressed storage + indexing).
- Advanced dashboards bundle: $2,500/month base + $95 per active dashboard seat.

Discounting: standard committed-credit discounts are 10% at $100k committed ARR, 18% at $250k, 25% at $500k+. For a 24-month commitment we can restructure to provide deeper credits (adds 3–5% additional discount).

If you can confirm average daily GB and expected active dashboard seats, Ben can refine the estimate and we can have a formal proposal by Friday. Happy to jump on a 30-min pricing call this afternoon if helpful.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Petrova <anya.p@cloudcatalog.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 6 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Observability add-ons — retention and tracing pricing questions

Anya — following up with the spreadsheet and a suggested mutual action plan. See attached RI_pricing_tiers_v3.xlsx (tabbed: assumptions, 90d-projection, discount-ladder). Key assumptions I used:

- Ingest average: 1.8 TB/day -> ~54 TB/month raw, compression factor 3x -> billable 18 TB/month for retention calculations.
- For 30-day hot retention: assume 18 TB * $0.18 = $3,240/month.
- For cold 90-day aggregated (post-aggregation): ~60 TB-month at $0.06 = $3,600/month.
- Tracing: 1.2M spans/day -> ~36M spans/month -> 36 * $0.50 = $18/month (math note: pricing is per 1M spans, so 36 * $0.50 = $18).
  (We put a floor of $200/month on tracing for index costs for small accounts.)
- Dashboards: estimate 15 active seats -> $2,500 + (15 * $95) = $3,925/month.

Net monthly run-rate (baseline): retention hot + cold + tracing floor + dashboards = ~$10,983/month -> ~$131,796/year.

Discount scenarios:
- 12-mo commit $150k ARR -> 12% discount and 1 month onboarding credit ($11k).
- 24-mo commit $300k ARR -> 20% discount and waived connector fee for first year ($30k value).

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan):
1) CloudCatalog provides final average ingest numbers by Thu EOD (Aug 6).
2) Redwood provides updated formal proposal and SOW by Fri EOD (Aug 7).
3) Procurement reviews and returns redlines by Tue (Aug 12).
4) Final sign + DocuSign by Aug 19 -> target provisioning Aug 23.

I've kept the numbers conservative; Rachel can push for a promotional uplift if you want faster close.

Attachments: RI_pricing_tiers_v3.xlsx

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Anya Petrova <anya.p@cloudcatalog.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cloudcatalog.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2026 08:53:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention and tracing pricing questions

Thanks Ben and Rachel — the detail is super helpful. A few quick follow-ups from procurement and product:

- Procurement: the baseline monthly run-rate looks reasonable, but we need a better list price vs committed price comparison in the proposal. Also please include standard SOC2 evidence and the last 12 months of uptime SLAs in the SOW appendix.
- Product: can you confirm if the cold-aggregation tier supports queries with 24-hour materialized rollups? That determines whether we should keep 90d full-fidelity or push more to aggregated cold.
- Discount ask: Procurement asked if a one-time 30% promotional discount for the first year is possible if we sign a 24-month commitment this week. They want that to offset re-platforming and migration costs.

We're past the EOD Friday ask because of internal review cycles — if you can get an updated formal proposal (with list vs committed pricing, SOC2 artifact link, and a proposed DocuSign packet) by Monday morning, we'll prioritize procurement review.

—Anya

Looping in for final approval on promotional credit. Hi team — I reviewed the numbers and the proposed MAP. Given CloudCatalog's usage profile and the strategic value of the account, we can offer the following concession to close this month:

- One-time migration credit equal to 20% of the first-year committed run-rate (applied as account credits over the first two billing cycles).
- For a 24-month commitment, an additional 5% off list (stacked with committed-credit discounts noted earlier).

We cannot meet a full 30% first-year promotional across all line items, but the combination above should bridge negotiation and keep contractual discounts aligned with our pricing guardrails. Rachel/Ben — please reflect these concessions in the formal proposal and include SOC2 (link below) and the DocuSign packet stub.
